source_text: Defuncto Gothoniel rursum malignum fecerunt. Absente iudice recidiva. Christus iudex noster semper vivat in nobis. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: With-dead Othniel again evil they-did. With-absent judge relapse. Christ judge our always let-him-live in us. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[When Othniel died they again did evil >> Bible:Judges 3:11-12]]. Without the judge comes relapse. Let Christ our judge always live in us. Amen.
